name: sites
description:
Enumerate registry site identifiers, sorted.

Returns:
    SitesResult: Distinct identifiers of sites; `["MAIN"]` applies if the registry
    contains none.

name: asset_ids
description:
Enumerate registered asset identifiers for a site.

Invoke `assets()` if registry metadata is additionally required.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.

Returns:
    AssetsResult: Sorted identifiers of assets and the associated count.

name: asset_detail
description:
Retrieve an individual asset’s registry information.

Comprises identity, type, description, location, status, installation date,
vintage plus the installed-sensor total. Names require `installed_sensors()`.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    asset_id: Exact asset identifier obtained through `asset_ids()`, e.g. `Chiller 6`.

Returns:
    AssetDetail: Available registry attributes; optional values are represented as null
    if absent.

name: measured_sensors
description:
Enumerate observed measurement fields within asset telemetry.

Produces a sorted union over the complete stream, omitting record metadata.
Invoke `installed_sensors()` for registry-assigned sensors; these can differ.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    asset_id: Exact asset identifier obtained through `asset_ids()`, e.g. `Chiller 6`.

Returns:
    SensorsResult: Names of observed measurement identifiers and the associated count.

name: installed_sensors
description:
Enumerate registry-assigned sensor names for an asset.

Invoke `measured_sensors()` for telemetry-observed fields; these lists can
be different.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    asset_id: Exact asset identifier obtained through `asset_ids()`, e.g. `Chiller 6`.

Returns:
    SensorsResult: Registry sensor identifiers in registry sequence, with their count.

name: assets
description:
Enumerate a site’s assets with concise registry metadata.

Invoke `asset_ids()` for identifiers alone; use `asset_detail()` for additional fields
concerning an individual asset.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    assettype: Optional asset-type restriction requiring exact equality that is case-sensitive, e.g.
        `PUMP`, alternatively `COMPRESSOR`.

Returns:
    AssetsWithMetadataResult: Identifier-ordered assets accompanied by description,
    type, vintage plus the installed-sensor total.

name: find_assets_by_sensors
description:
Identify site assets through assigned or observed sensor names.

Search excludes assets not registered under `site_name`. Repeated queries are
eliminated while retaining the order of initial occurrence.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    sensors: Sensor identifiers, or fragments if `substring` is enabled.
    match: `all` requires each query to match; `any` requires one or more matches.
    substring: Select case-insensitive fragment comparison rather than exact,
        case-sensitive equality.
    source: `measured` targets observed fields; `installed` targets
        registry sensor assignments; the default is `measured`.

Returns:
    FindAssetsResult: Search configuration and matched assets with the specific
    matched sensor identifiers.

name: stream_extent
description:
Inspect asset telemetry volume and temporal extent.

Optional restrictions comprise a measured sensor plus a ISO 8601 half-open interval:
`start` denotes an included boundary; `end` an excluded one. Sensor-filtered records qualify
only for a present, non-null field. Bounds and observation timestamps
must uniformly include timezone offsets or uniformly omit them; aware timestamps undergo
instant-based comparison irrespective of differing offsets.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    asset_id: Exact asset identifier obtained through `asset_ids()`, e.g. `Chiller 6`.
    sensor: An optional exact field identifier obtained through `measured_sensors()`.
        Reserved metadata identifiers, including `asset_id` and `timestamp`, cannot be
        accepted as sensor identifiers.
    start: Optional included lower boundary expressed as an date or datetime formatted using ISO 8601.
    end: Optional excluded upper boundary expressed as an date or datetime formatted using ISO 8601.

Returns:
    StreamExtentResult: Initial/final qualifying timestamps, record
    count, indication of exceeding a page of 1000 records, and mean
    interval derived from count and temporal extent.

name: history
description:
Retrieve a chronological telemetry page for an individual asset.

Optional bounds define a ISO 8601 half-open interval. Projection via `sensors` selects
exact measured fields; omission includes every present measured field in each
row. Rows retain `asset_id` and `timestamp` while omitting all other record
metadata.

The initial page leaves `cursor` unset. A true `has_more` requires resubmitting the
identical query using `next_cursor`. Each cursor is opaque and query-specific. Timestamp
offsets are governed by `stream_extent()`.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    asset_id: Exact asset identifier obtained through `asset_ids()`, e.g. `Chiller 6`.
    start: An optional included lower boundary expressed in ISO 8601.
    end: Optional excluded upper boundary expressed in ISO 8601.
    sensors: Optional nonempty list specifying exact measured identifiers. Duplicate
        names are eliminated without reordering.
    limit: Per-page observation ceiling within 1–1000.
    cursor: The opaque `next_cursor` obtained from this query’s preceding page.

Returns:
    HistoryResult: Observations after projection, returned quantity, echoed boundaries,
    and subsequent-page cursor fields.

name: latest_reading
description:
Retrieve an individual asset’s most recent telemetry observation.

Omission of `sensor` includes every measured field of the latest record. If a sensor is
supplied, the tool selects the most recent qualifying record with that field non-null and present.
Record comparison uses parsed timestamps according to `stream_extent()`.

`age_seconds` denotes current UTC time minus the observation
timestamp. Offsetless timestamps are treated as UTC; negative age
signifies a future observation timestamp.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    asset_id: Exact asset identifier obtained through `asset_ids()`, e.g. `Chiller 6`.
    sensor: An optional exact field identifier obtained through `measured_sensors()`. Reserved
        metadata identifiers are invalid as sensors.

Returns:
    LatestReadingResult: Chosen timestamp and values with age expressed in seconds.

name: sensor_coverage
description:
Summarize observation coverage excluding nulls for each measured sensor.

Examines the complete timestamped stream. `non_null_count` counts any present,
values that are non-null, regardless of type. Exclusively null-valued fields receive zero
count with null boundaries. Timestamp offsets follow `stream_extent()`.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    asset_id: Exact asset identifier obtained through `asset_ids()`, e.g. `Chiller 6`.

Returns:
    SensorCoverageResult: Scanned timestamped-record count and sensor-specific counts
    with temporal boundaries, ordered by field name.

name: sensor_stats
description:
Compute numerical summaries over one measured sensor or every measured sensor.

Omission of `sensor` selects each measured field. Optional boundaries define a
ISO 8601 half-open interval. Timestamp offsets follow `stream_extent()`.

Numerical summaries include numeric strings as well as finite numbers.
Present non-numeric values, booleans, nulls and values that are non-finite enter
`null_count`; absent fields enter neither count. Here, `stddev` denotes
population standard deviation, yielding `0.0` with a single numeric observation; none yields null.

Args:
    site_name: The requested site’s exact identifier, e.g. `MAIN`; invoke `sites()` to
        obtain the valid site identifiers.
    asset_id: Exact asset identifier obtained through `asset_ids()`, e.g. `Chiller 6`.
    sensor: An optional exact field identifier obtained through `measured_sensors()`. Omission will
        summarize each measured field.
    start: Optional included lower boundary expressed in ISO 8601.
    end: Optional excluded upper boundary expressed in ISO 8601.

Returns:
    SensorStatsResult: Field-specific numeric/null counts, mean, range,
    population standard deviation, with first/last timestamps of numeric observations.

name: json_reader
description: Parses a JSON file’s contents and supplies the resulting data.

name: get_sensor_catalog
description:
Retrieve the catalog’s sensor types.

Entries comprise `sensor` plus `description`. Omission of sensor enumerates cataloged
sensor types in full; a supplied sensor requests exact name matching.

name: get_asset_catalog
description:
Retrieve asset classes with their catalog categories.

Entries comprise `category`, `category_description`, `asset`, plus
`description`. Unspecified filters enumerate all cataloged classes; otherwise specify
asset, category, or both to require exact matching.

name: get_failure_mode_catalog
description:
Retrieve the failure-mode catalog organized by asset category.

These entries comprise `category`, `failure_mode`, plus `description`. Leave filters unspecified
to enumerate the complete mode catalog; otherwise specify failure_mode, category, or both
to require exact matching.

name: current_date_time
description: Supplies the present date and time in JSON representation.

name: current_time_english
description: Renders the present time in English.

name: get_failure_modes
description:
READ known failure modes associated with the specified class of assets.

Args:
    asset_class: Class being queried, e.g. "pump". The tool normalizes case, whitespace,
        digits, hyphens and underscores prior to querying.

name: generate_failure_modes
description:
GENERATE a fresh or expanded failure-mode list associated with a specified asset class.

The tool performs no database writes. If normalized `asset_class`
is stored, the existing modes supply context
for additional generation by the LLM. Without stored modes, the LLM
produces a fresh list.

Args:
    asset_class: Class under consideration, e.g. "pump". The tool normalizes case,
        whitespace, digits, hyphens and underscores prior to
        issuing the LLM prompt.
    max_modes: Requested upper bound on newly generated failure modes from the LLM.

name: add_failure_modes
description:
WRITE failure modes associated with an asset class into database storage.

Retains existing modes and merges supplied modes without case sensitivity,
reporting exclusively added modes. Use when generated or curated
modes should become retrievable through subsequent `get_failure_modes` retrieval.

Args:
    asset_class: Class being modified, e.g. "pump". The tool normalizes case, whitespace,
        digits, hyphens and underscores prior to persistence.
    failure_modes: Modes to append for the specified asset class.
    exhaustive: Specify true exclusively for a stored set believed complete. When
        omitted, the tool retains the prior value; newly created records default to false.
    source: Provenance, optionally associated with the persisted set.

name: list_workorders
description:
Enumerate work orders, optionally restricted by site, asset, status, priority or dates.
status permits OPEN / APPROVED_PENDING; setting page_size=0 retrieves every match together.

name: get_workorder
description: Retrieve one work order by site plus number.

name: get_workorder_tasks
description: Enumerate a work-order’s subordinate task records.

name: get_workorder_costs
description: Provide actual spending by labor, material, service and tool for one work order.

name: get_workorder_actuals_vs_planned
description: Report work-order hour/cost variances: estimates versus actuals.

name: get_workorder_kpis
description: Site KPIs comprising totals, backlog, overdue work, mean completion, priority/asset distributions.

name: get_schedule_calendar
description: Group scheduled, non-terminal orders by day within date bounds.

name: get_my_assigned_workorders
description: Retrieve work orders allocated to the specified technician (labor code).

name: get_failure_codes
description:
Retrieve the FCC reference catalog of failure codes held in CouchDB.

An unspecified ``code`` enumerates available failure codes; supply an exact code
exemplified by ``FC001`` for case-insensitive matching; CouchDB metadata is excluded
from results.

name: generate_work_order
description: Establish a work order in WAPPR status, attaching agent/trigger/evidence provenance via aob_source.

name: update_workorder
description: Amend the editable attributes of a work order.

name: approve_workorder
description: Authorize the work order into APPR.

name: assign_technician
description: Allocate a technician; append a wplabor line.

name: close_workorder
description: Finalize a work order in COMP with recorded actuals plus resolution.

name: cancel_workorder
description: Cancel the work order into CAN.
